title: Genrupt
viewer: Hiring manager, technical reviewer, or product leader
takeaway: Genrupt moved from working AI media tools to a commercial seller workflow platform for paid teams.

scenes.intent: Paid seller teams needed more than AI tools. Payments, credits, and long-running work had to hold together.
scenes.headline: Paid teams needed one reliable platform.

scenes.intent: I helped turn Genrupt into a seller workflow platform. Projects, billing, and work shared one system.
scenes.headline: Genrupt became a seller workflow platform.

scenes.intent: Paid teams could subscribe, buy credits, and track usage. Billing and work stayed connected.
scenes.headline: Billing and work stayed connected.
scenes.assetAlt: Public redacted Genrupt subscription and pricing surface.

scenes.intent: AI helpers could only do allowed work. Each workflow kept a clear boundary.
scenes.headline: AI helpers stayed inside clear boundaries.
scenes.assetAlt: Public redacted Genrupt Agent Access surface.

scenes.intent: Seller work became easier to run. The platform supported the first 100 paying customers.
scenes.headline: The platform supported real paying teams.
scenes.assetAlt: Public redacted Genrupt seller workflow result surface.

scenes.intent: AI tools ready for paying teams. One commercial workflow platform.
scenes.headline: AI work ready for paying teams.
